title: Codex review result
description: Contract for the structured findings Codex returns for a lane diff. Produced by the manual review hop (tools/relay/manual_codex_review.ps1) and consumed by the codex-finding-resolver agent. Local-only: never carries secrets, child PII, or licensed S.A.M. question text.

branch.description: The lane branch under review, e.g. lane/relay-manual-loop.

base.description: The base the diff was taken against, normally ATLAS-ASSESSMENT.

reviewed_commit.description: Full or short SHA of the lane head that was reviewed.

reviewer.description: Reviewer identity. Manual hop sets this to 'codex'.

summary.description: One-paragraph overall verdict from the reviewer.

findings.description: Zero or more findings. An empty array means the reviewer found nothing to change.

finding.description: A single review finding. The resolver treats Codex as an independent reviewer, not an oracle: it confirms each finding against the code before applying.

id.description: Stable handle for the finding within this review, e.g. F1, F2.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding applies to.

location.description: Optional line range within the file.

severity.description: blocker/high must be resolved before the PR is mergeable (AGENTS.md required checks); medium/low/info are discretionary.

description.description: What is wrong and why it matters. Plain, specific, points at the code.

suggested_fix.description: Optional concrete fix. The resolver may apply, adapt, or reject it.
